promise: Meta announced Quest 3 availability for October 10, 2023, starting at US$499.99 for 128GB.
description: Meta's September 27 announcement specified an October 10, 2023 release, starting at US$499.99 for 128GB. Subsequent reporting confirms the headset launched on that date.
evidence: Meta's Connect announcement establishes the October 10 target and the base-model price.
Android Central's retrospective availability account confirms the October 10, 2023 launch. This rates product availability, not delivery of every individual pre-order.
